3. Handoff rules for night shift, needs your input on edge cases (Gus + Soren, 20 min)
4. Customer Desk scripts + escalation path (Yusuf, 10 min)
5. Open questions (Dmitri)

Sorry again, and thank you!!! Coffee's on me!!
— Ines"},{"spec_id":"spec_0260","text":"hey all, fwding Callum's invite since Thandi wasnt on the orig. also heads up, the lot B gate is broken again so park on the street. and it's Sam's bday Thurs, cake in the kitchen at 3!!
